cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded Teacher’s Platinum card providing lifestyle rewards, milestone perks, and partner-linked privileges, tailored for brand-loyal customers.

benefitRows.name: Gift
benefitRows.offer: Get a special gift of 500 reward points on Teacher's Day (5 Sept) every year.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, hold an active HDFC Teacher's Platinum credit card. On Teacher’s Day (September 5th) every year, you will automatically receive 500 reward points as a special gift credited to your card account. For details or issues, contact HDFC customer support at 1800 267 4333.
